chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Hamadani, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kaslan, from Maysar the seller of al-Zutti, and he was his maternal uncle, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Eat the onion, for in it are three qualities: it improves the breath, strengthens the gums, and increases in the semen and sexual intercourse.'
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of eating onions according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the medicinal virtues of onions, emphasizing their role in enhancing physical vitality and sexual health. This narration reflects the broader Shia tradition of *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine), where common foods are valued for their holistic benefits on both bodily strength and reproductive capacity.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Ali Al hamdany, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kaslaan, from Maysar Baya’a the Zaty, and he was his maternal uncle who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Eat the onion for therein are three qualities – It aromatises the breath, and strengthens the gums, and increases in the water and the copulation’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bandar from his father from Muhammad ibn Ah al-Hamadaniy from al-Hassan ibn Ah al-Kaslan from Muyassir Bayya’ al-Zuttiy who was his maternal uncle has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘You must eat onion; it has three qualities; it is well flavored, brings firmness to one’s gums, increases one’s seeds and the ability to go to bed with one’s wife.’”
